div.div:
The cut is a parameter, not a fact: variants
live side by side, so re-indexing is a
comparison rather than a border.
What counts as a heading is the parser's
answer; the text between them is sliced from
the file, so nothing is rewritten on the way
in.
The preflight re-cuts every variant and
compares the text of each chunk: a changed cut
can keep its row count exactly.
